purpose: Show a bounded operational workflow with selectable stages, integrated progress, and contextual detail.
accessibility: Expose the journey as a labelled navigation region with an ordered list of keyboard-reachable buttons.
Expose each percentage through visible text and progressbar semantics, with the selected stage detail linked from its control.
Keep selection feedback in a labelled live detail region and preserve visible focus.
When detailMode is drawer, expose the selected stage through the canonical right-side DetailDrawer and restore focus to its stage control on close.
responsive: Keep the milestone sequence inside a bounded horizontal scroll region when the available width is narrow.
Preserve the ordered stage, state, progress, and detail contracts without introducing a mobile-only component.
Let the canonical DetailDrawer become full-width at compact widths while retaining its own scroll owner.
motion: Animate workflow-stage entry and selected detail changes with shared transition variables.
Use the shared overlay motion for drawer entry and exit, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
